title.zh-CN: 长期反复气短与新近活动能力下降
title.en: Longstanding recurrent breathlessness with recent functional decline

summary.zh-CN: 有血管炎病史的老年患者气短长期反复，常规心肺治疗效果不佳，需要寻找未解释的肺循环问题。
summary.en: An older patient with vasculitis has persistent breathlessness despite conventional heart/lung treatment.

openingLine.zh-CN: 一年反复胸闷气急，轻度活动就加重，夜里尚能平卧。

question.zh-CN: 气短多久，什么活动会加重？
question.en: How long has breathlessness lasted and what worsens it?

answer.zh-CN: 一年反复胸闷气急，轻度活动就加重，夜里尚能平卧。
answer.en: Chest tightness and breathlessness recurred for a year, worsened by light activity; lying flat at night remained possible.

finding.en: Cyanotic lips, heart rate 108/min and respiratory rate 26/min; clear lungs, accentuated pulmonary second sound and pitting leg oedema.

text.zh-CN: 吸氧浓度约33%时PaO2 54.4 mmHg、PaCO2 33.7 mmHg；BNP 2203 ng/L。超声右心增大、右室壁6.4 mm，估算肺动脉收缩压83.5 mmHg，左室EF73%；下肢双侧深静脉血栓。
text.en: At approximately 33% inspired oxygen, PaO2 54.4 mmHg and PaCO2 33.7 mmHg; BNP 2203 ng/L. Echo showed enlarged right heart, wall 6.4 mm and estimated pulmonary systolic pressure 83.5 mmHg with LVEF 73%; bilateral leg DVT was found.

text.zh-CN: 双肺叶及部分段动脉充盈缺损，左侧偏心附壁；原文诊断慢性血栓栓塞性肺高压。未给右心导管、V/Q或规范抗凝后复评。
text.en: Bilateral lobar/segmental filling defects included eccentric wall-adherent left-sided thrombus; the source diagnosed CTEPH. Right-heart catheterisation, V/Q and reassessment after standard anticoagulation were not supplied.

text.en: Anticoagulation and NIV were followed by improvement and discharge after one week, with continued warfarin and coagulation monitoring; long-term results were not provided.

prompt.zh-CN: 早期证据最需要关注哪一机制？
prompt.en: Which mechanism deserves priority from the early evidence?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 肺血管阻塞与右心负荷，不能仅按左心衰或少量肺炎解释
text.en: Pulmonary vascular obstruction and right-heart load rather than left-heart failure or minor pneumonia alone

feedback.zh-CN: 低氧、右心改变和DVT构成一致方向。
feedback.en: Hypoxaemia, right-heart changes and DVT form a coherent pattern.

text.zh-CN: 左室EF正常即可排除所有心肺病
text.en: Normal LVEF excludes all cardiopulmonary disease

feedback.zh-CN: 右心和肺循环仍有明确异常。
feedback.en: Right-heart and pulmonary circulation abnormalities remain.

text.zh-CN: 少量CT阴影充分解释全部重度低氧
text.en: Minor CT opacities fully explain severe hypoxaemia

feedback.zh-CN: 影像负荷与临床严重度不匹配。
feedback.en: The imaging burden does not match clinical severity.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 偏心附壁血栓和右室增厚支持慢性过程，但现代CTEPH确认资料不完整
text.en: Eccentric adherent thrombus and right-ventricular thickening support chronicity, while modern CTEPH confirmation remains incomplete

feedback.zh-CN: 超声估压不是右心导管，不能补造血流动力学。
feedback.en: Echo pressure estimation is not catheterisation and haemodynamics cannot be invented.

text.zh-CN: 已证明血管炎就是唯一血栓原因
text.en: Vasculitis is proven as the sole thrombotic cause

feedback.zh-CN: 原文只提出关联解释，未完成唯一因果证明。
feedback.en: The source proposes an association without proving sole causation.

text.zh-CN: 所有血栓均只能是八天内新发
text.en: All thrombi must have arisen within eight days

feedback.zh-CN: 一年病程及右室肥厚提示更长过程。
feedback.en: A year of symptoms and right-wall thickening suggest a longer process.

prompt.zh-CN: 当前长期计划如何避免旧文局限？
prompt.en: How should a current plan avoid the historical limitation?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 转肺高压/CTEPH中心完成确认并由多学科评估手术、介入、药物与抗凝
text.en: Refer to a PH/CTEPH centre for confirmation and multidisciplinary surgical, interventional, medical and anticoagulation assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 年龄或双侧病变不能单独替代现代可手术性判断。
feedback.en: Age or bilateral disease alone cannot replace modern operability assessment.

text.zh-CN: 因69岁和双侧血栓直接永久判定不可手术
text.en: Permanently declare inoperability from age 69 and bilateral thrombi

feedback.zh-CN: 需要有经验团队结合可达病变和合并症判断。
feedback.en: An experienced team must assess accessible lesions and comorbidity.

text.zh-CN: 无创通气改善就无需血栓治疗
text.en: Improvement with NIV removes need for thrombotic care

feedback.zh-CN: 支持改善不等于血管阻塞消失。
feedback.en: Supportive improvement does not mean vascular obstruction has resolved.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明肺实质轻微改变不足解释整体。；承认右心导管、V/Q、规范疗程后评估及长期结局缺失。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Minor parenchymal changes do not explain the whole picture.; acknowledge Right-heart catheterisation, V/Q, post-treatment reassessment and long-term outcomes are missing. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 历史影像和长期病程支持慢性血栓栓塞性肺循环病，需保留现代确认缺口。
conclusion.en: Historical imaging and course support chronic thromboembolic pulmonary vascular disease, with gaps in modern confirmation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 肺实质轻微改变不足解释整体。
keyReasoning.en: Minor parenchymal changes do not explain the whole picture.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 右心肥厚和附壁血栓支持慢性。
keyReasoning.en: Right-heart thickening and adherent clot support chronicity.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 关联疾病不等于唯一因果。
keyReasoning.en: Associated disease is not sole causation.

teachingPoints.en: Echo estimates differ from catheter measurements.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 治疗选择已超出旧文二分法。
teachingPoints.en: Treatment choices extend beyond the historical binary.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不模拟无记录的通气反应曲线。
teachingPoints.en: Do not simulate undocumented ventilation response curves.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 右心导管、V/Q、规范疗程后评估及长期结局缺失。
unknowns.en: Right-heart catheterisation, V/Q, post-treatment reassessment and long-term outcomes are missing.
